meeting: Post Quantum Transaction Signature (PQTS) Breakout #16 - September 30, 2026

testnet_status.highlight: Testnet v0.1 (ERC-4337 + SPHINCS variant) and v0.2 (ERC-4337 + native frame tx via EIP-8141) already deployed; v0.3 targeting mempool aggregation
EIP-8288 (signature aggregation) is next target; Emil's LeanVM fork is parameterized to match the Lean SPHINCS parameters already shipped on the testnet
Nethermind (and ethrex) to ship embedded LeanVM for native block verification — no precompile or Solidity contract; extends the existing ECDSA verification path
Preliminary aggregation throughput: ~280 signatures/sec with the upstream Lean SPHINCS parameters, ~20/sec with the forked parameters used on the testnet

eip_8288_aggregation_design.highlight: Block structure for v0.3: transactions stripped of individual signatures + single constant-size aggregated proof SA produced by LeanVM; size independent of tx count
Targeting EIP-8288 test case 7: the aggregator doubles as block builder and wraps test case 1 with a recursive STARK
Wrapper object, broadcast at the network level, carries the dependency reference plus the actual Lean SPHINCS signature; the VERIFY frame only checks the dependency, decoupled from it
Open problem: how receiving Nethermind/ethrex nodes verify the aggregated LeanVM proof natively without precompile; consensus is native integration required, not yet implemented

ethrex_prototype.highlight: lambdaclass ethrex branch eip-8288 has working in-mempool aggregation prototype with LeanVM; benchmarks committed; covers validation and mempool aggregation

action_items.action: Antonio to invite Vitalik / Tomas (EIP-8288 authors) to a future call for design clarification
Stefano De Angelis (Nethermind) to bring concrete test-case-7 solution proposal to next call

decisions.decision: v0.3 testnet will aggregate once per block rather than on a ~1 second interval, as the simplest first end-to-end milestone

targets.target: Testnet v0.3 — first end-to-end EIP-8288 aggregation with Nethermind or ethrex (timeline TBD; next call in two weeks)
